text:
alice: heads-up — nightly trivy pipeline started failing around 02:12 UTC, intermittent worker OOMs. affecting prod-scan-034. https://ci/redwood/runs/2345 :eyes:
scanner-bot: ALERT: trivy-worker-12 OOM at 2026-03-19T02:12:34Z. PID 1423 killed. RSS peaked at 6.1GB. Logs:
```
 2026-03-19T02:12:33Z trivy scan started repo=monorepo/frontend
 2026-03-19T02:12:34Z scanning layer 34/120
 2026-03-19T02:12:34Z fatal: runtime: out of memory
```
bob: saw that too. runs spike when we hit the big monorepo. current worker concurrency is 8 in runners.yaml. might be too aggressive for 16GB instances.
carlos: also seeing GHAS runner timeouts while waiting for artifacts — a cascade: trivy backpressure -> artifact service timeouts -> GHAS job 504s. logs show repeated retries.
diana: could suppression-sync be making it worse? when the suppression list is large and the mapping changed last night, scanner does extra lookups per finding. we changed the suppression index mapping in the migration at 2026-03-18 23:00 UTC.
alice: we rolled that mapping. logs show a few KMS decrypt timeouts too — looks like the suppression metadata is encrypted and we hit kms client timeouts during heavy traffic. @bob can you check worker mem limits + KMS client settings? filing a ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-789
bob: quick diagnostics — bumping worker mem to 6G reduces OOMs but still spikes. short-term mitigation: reduce default concurrency to 4, add jitter and backoff on suppression sync calls. also increase kms_client.timeout to 10s. :thumbsup:
carlos: i'll rollback suppression mapping to v1 and rerun the nightly smoke suite. ETA ~20m.
scanner-bot: ACTION: suppression-index rolled back: suppression-index:v2 -> v1 by carlos at 2026-03-19T02:34:10Z.
diana: after rollback two consecutive pipeline runs are green. we should still add a postmortem and better migration tests. add a lag metric for suppression-sync to telemetry.
alice: recorded follow-ups in the ticket SEC-789: add e2e for suppression migrations, alert on trivy_worker_mem > 80%, parametrize default concurrency, and add KMS timeout dashboards. assigned to @bob @carlos @diana. link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-789
bob: i'll open a PR to change default concurrency to 4 and add adaptive backoff. draft config snippet I'm testing:
```
runners:
  trivy:
    concurrency: 4
    worker_memory_limit: 6GB
    suppression_sync:
      backoff:
        initial: 200ms
        max: 5s
    kms_client:
      timeout_seconds: 10
```
bob: will also add a crash-loop alert and a memory spike threshold to PagerDuty.
alice: great. once PR and alerting are in place we'll schedule a short postmortem sync tomorrow. thanks all. :wave:
